seo.title: Manage Your License | SolPrompter
seo.description: Validate and manage a SolPrompter license key for unlimited Auto Scroll.
seo.ogDescription: Add a valid license key to unlock unlimited Auto Scroll on this browser.

hero.title: Enter your license key.
hero.description: Enter the license key delivered after your Polar purchase. SolPrompter checks its live status and unlocks unlimited Auto Scroll while the key remains active.
hero.localNote: Your key is saved only in this browser's local storage.

form.title: Unlock unlimited Auto Scroll
form.description: After checkout, open the email from Polar and paste the complete license key exactly as it appears there.
form.label: License key
form.help: The key is sent securely to the SolPrompter license API for validation.

items.title: Complete checkout
items.description: Buy an eligible SolPrompter plan through Polar.

items.title: Check your email
items.description: After checkout, open the email from Polar to find your license key.

items.title: Validate here
items.description: This page checks the current key status and expiration before enabling unlimited Auto Scroll.

client.validMessage: License verified. Unlimited Auto Scroll is active on this browser.
client.invalidMessage: This key is not active. Check the key and try again.
client.configurationMessage: License validation is being set up. Please try again shortly.
client.networkMessage: The license service could not be reached. Your saved key was not changed.
client.removeMessage: This browser will return to the Free plan. Your Polar purchase and license are not canceled.
client.removedMessage: The license key was removed from this browser.
